description: govern-my-chatbot: Claude Code asks the creator before Claude changes a chatbot rulebook (*.nv-world.md) with its edit tools or a shell command that touches it, and tells them if a rulebook changes any other way. If the guard itself can't run, Claude Code asks.

hooks.command: node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/govern-my-chatbot/hooks/rulebook-guard.mjs" pre || printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"The rulebook guard could not run (is Node.js installed?), so Claude Code is asking before this change."}}'

node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/govern-my-chatbot/hooks/rulebook-guard.mjs" pre-bash || printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"The rulebook guard could not run (is Node.js installed?), so Claude Code is asking before this command."}}'
